description: Lists the messages given a "send_at" that have not left yet, soonest first: when each leaves (in the zone of the person you act for), from which address, to whom, the subject and text, and the thread an answer goes into. A message that has left is no longer here but in its thread. One that could not leave stays, with state "failed" and the reason, until it is cancelled.

address.description: Narrows to the messages leaving from one address, from list_sender_addresses.

name: list_scheduled_sends
title: List the messages scheduled to leave later
